snippet.title: Frostpunk 1886 | Developer Update | Digital Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
❄️ Step behind the scenes of #Frostpunk 1886 and wishlist now: https://re.11bits.com/i35

Game Director Maciej Sułecki walks you through what’s coming: refined mechanics, a major visual upgrade powered by Unreal Engine, and most importantly - a vision that goes far beyond a simple remaster.

We’re expanding the experience with a wealth of brand-new, unique content.
